incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx + timeouts hitting /v1/generate across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. p95 ~1.4s, p99 ~3.8s, error rate +12% in last 6m. Correlation: cohort=interactive; 15m window start.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: main@7f3b2a -> service/runtime (started 3876549005, finished 3876549300). No automatic rollback triggered.
Chris (SRE): seeing the same in datadog. traffic pattern looks normal, CPU on GPUs fine, but request queue depth and connection waiters spiked. guessing a runtime path slowed token flush.
Tara (Runtime): I rolled model-variant profiling for that deploy (quantization tweak + kernel selection heuristics). Reproduced a local sim where long sequences (>=1024) cause head-of-line stalls in the kv-flush path.
Miguel (oncall): paging now. @Patrick can infra isolate the new workers (node pool alpha) and route traffic off them? we should consider rollback if mitigation not immediate.
Patrick (EngInfra): starting route-shift to fallback pool (stable-pool) now. Will disable 7f3b2a instances from LB. ETA ~2m.
Amy (C-Success): any customer-facing impact? do we need a banner or workspace-level notice?
Chris (SRE): customer impact: some interactive sessions see timeouts ~1-2s extra, non-blocking for batches but interactive UX degraded. CS reported 3 customers opening threads. recommend holding comms until we confirm rollback/mitigation.
Tara (Runtime): quick test: hotpatch candidate (revert kernel heuristic) ready. If infra can reroute to stable pool, I'll apply hotpatch on a single node for canary.
Patrick (EngInfra): reroute complete. traffic on new-pool now 85% -> stable. quarantined node group: runtime-alpha-3.
incidents-bot: metric snapshot (6m window):
```
p95: baseline 120ms -> 1400ms
p99: baseline 420ms -> 3800ms
5xx rate: 0.6% -> 12.3%
inflight queue length (avg): 30 -> 420
avg token latency: 9ms -> 110ms
```
Miguel (oncall): Tara, how fast to hotpatch single node? can we validate reduction?
Tara (Runtime): applying hotpatch to one quarantined node now. patch: revert kernel heuristic commit b4c2.
Tara (Runtime): hotpatch applied to node runtime-alpha-3. Observability: p95 on canary node dropped to 140ms within 45s. overall cluster started improving.
Chris (SRE): good signal. entire service p95 trending down to ~200ms. still some noisy tails.
Patrick (EngInfra): given signal, recommend full rollback of the deploy to be safe. I'll issue revert via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: rollback main@7f3b2a -> main@3a9d1c. Commits: revert quant-kernel-selection (triggered 3876550002). Expected restart across workers in 60-120s.
Miguel (oncall): executing rollback. paging: i'll keep paged list updated. @Amy please prepare an internal incident note for CS.
Amy (C-Success): drafting note: short status, affected endpoints, mitigation (rollback in progress), ETA to resolution ~5m. will update if we have broad regressions.
incidents-bot: deploy events: workers gracefully drained and restarted. new config back to main@3a9d1c.
Chris (SRE): post-rollback metrics: p95 130ms, p99 450ms, 5xx back down to 0.8%. inflight queue normalized to ~28.
Patrick (EngInfra): confirming all traffic on stable-pool, quarantined runtime-alpha group remains cordoned.
Miguel (oncall): handoff: I'm oncall for next 30m. Tagging postmortem owner: @Tara to run the blameless postmortem. Action items: (1) Tara to open PR for safer kernel fallback gating; (2) EngInfra to add deploy-time canary traffic knob; (3) SRE to add alert that ties deploy commit -> sudden queue-length growth.
Tara (Runtime): ack. will create PR + include regression test for long sequence workload.
Amy (C-Success): sent CS update: "We detected increased timeouts and 5xx; rollback applied; monitoring shows service healthy. We'll follow up with postmortem and customers who reported issues."
Chris (SRE): we'll keep the incident channel open for 1h for escalation. Logging/trace dump attached for PM: `trace-sample-3876549999.log` (internal link).
Patrick (EngInfra): leaving follow-ups in infra board (ticket INF-3281).
Miguel (oncall): closing live mitigation. next: postmortem + action tracking. If anyone sees a regression re-open thread. :thumbsup:
Tara (Runtime): quick note: avoid shipping kernel heuristic without a gated canary on sequence-length skew. Lesson learned.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: 46m duration. root cause suspected: kernel selection heuristic + quantization change -> head-of-line token flush stalls under long-seq traffic. Rollback restored prior kernel selection and normalized latency.
